sources.entry: SimpleDMS - Easy-to-use, metadata-driven, document management system (DMS) for small businesses that sorts documents almost by itself. (Source Code, Clients) AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: SimpleDMS is an open source, metadata-driven document management system for small businesses that uses tags and workspaces to file and retrieve documents.
summary.what_it_does: SimpleDMS is a document management system aimed at small businesses, built around a metadata-driven concept. Documents are categorized with a tag system. Workspaces (spaces) provide shared or private access to documents. The README says the app is meant for filing and finding documents quickly after a short familiarization period. It is also offered as a hosted SaaS at simpledms.eu and simpledms.ch. The README states the repo contains all features relevant for use by a single company or family. It says there is no analytics or tracking in the app. The README mentions a runtime profiling guide for production CPU and memory diagnostics.
use_cases: document management for a small business
sharing documents within a team using workspaces
private document storage for a family or single company
self-hosted alternative to a hosted document filing service
notable: Metadata-driven filing using a tag system and workspaces
Private and shared workspaces for document access
Available as both self-hosted source and a hosted SaaS
No analytics or tracking integrated, per the README
Dark mode and a German-language first-steps video on YouTube
caveats: Paid control plane for multi-tenant SaaS management is closed behind a paywall (source-available)
Future features are not guaranteed to remain in the free open source version
Paid LTS and support plans are optional; prices are on the website
Setup details and technical documentation are on the external SimpleDMS website, not in the README
